title: A weighted value from fixed references and swing ratings

cases.says: every start gets one value, a start with no benefit in any measure is worth 0, and the ranking lists every start from the highest value down
the weights are the swing ratings divided by their total, so they sum to 1
the whole value table matches the reference, each measure divided by its fixed reference
withdrawing a project changes no other project's value, because the references do not come from the candidates
restating risk in $M together with its reference leaves every value and the ranking unchanged
starts of equal value are ranked by their key, so the ranking is the same in every run
